correctness.rationale: The spectral projectors of the unweighted K_(1,n-1) star at 0,1,n give exact Rademacher sign-count weights w0=(n-2K)^2/n^2, w1=4K(n-1-K)/[n(n-1)], wn=4K^2/[n^2(n-1)], K~Bin(n-1,1/2). The first three moments give the two-node Jacobi matrix and exact nonnegative residual Q_n-T2=(n-2K)^2*d0/[t(t+1)(t+n)*dt], with d0=4K^2(n-1-K)/[n+(n-4)K]. k=0 is early Krylov termination, treated exactly. It is strictly positive at k=1 for n>=3, hence strict negative expected bias. Fixed t>0 and binomial CLT plus subGaussian moment bounds give (T1-tau)/n -> -1/[(t+1)(t+2)] and (T2-tau) => Z^2/(t+1)^2-1/[t(t+1)] with all fixed absolute moments; bias limit -1/[t(t+1)^2], variance limit 2/(t+1)^4. Independent direct-rational star action and resolvent checks for n=3..13 and t=1/3,2,7/2 reproduced residual; file scope_worker08_checks_20261106.py emits ONE_STAR_EXACT_PASS. Finite checks do not prove the CLT.
